description: Ratcheted raw-UI budgets for bounded-context ui/ and deployable production TSX consumers. Counts may fall below budget; new raw host UI or increases over budget fail verify:static.

ignored: tests, specs, stories, fixtures, and non-production files
classification.preferredAlternative: Use @chase-sets/design-system primitives/components such as Page, Stack/Cluster, Text, Button, TextInput, and DataTable/Table.
classification.escapeHatch: Add an allowList entry with path, tagName, node markers, and reason.

allowList.reason: The public waitlist owns one raw main landmark id for skip-link targeting.
Deployable composition roots may expose raw main landmarks while composing bounded-context UI.
